Definition: perhaps a military boot (as a protection from mud
BiblicalUsage: çᵉʼôwn is simply a military boot. Scripture uses it in Isaiah, and the context leaves nothing to guess at.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that çᵉʼôwn is no exception: no word in Scripture is filler.
